name: report_bundle
title: Hash-bound report bundle
description: Build a metadata-only, hash-bound bundle for one existing run: the run manifest, the bound analysis plus dag/flags/markers/phrases (accepted only via scripts/report.py lineage rules), the fixed S2 receipt registry with computed binding classes, a structured projection of the bound operator annotation store and small derived CSV tables for the optional Quarto report. Stage WAVs are stream-hashed and recorded by name and sha256 only; no audio or video bytes, media URLs or free-text notes are copied. Output goes to a fresh gitignored artifacts/s2/report_d6/bundles directory; run directories are never written.
intent: Give the optional R/Quarto report (and agents) a verifiable, privacy-preserving evidence package whose every value is hash-bound to the take, while keeping measurements, quoted receipt figures, synthetic-bank results, operator labels and unknowns distinct.

run_dir.description: Existing run directory with manifest.json (source.sha256 and output_sha256); read-only, no symlink components.

analysis_run_dir.description: Optional run holding analysis.json when run_dir has none; otherwise derived from capture_profile_application.authoring_dir. Must share the run's source sha256.

annotation_store.description: Optional review-annotations-v2.json; bound only when its source and manifest sha256 equal the run's. Only structured fields are projected.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard worker deadline; the build streams sha256 over stage files (about 140 MB for the demo run) and decodes nothing.

limitations: Receipt figures are quoted from each receipt, not re-measured; a source_bound_different_analyzed_input receipt describes a different derivative of the same take.
Synthetic generated-bank results are never operator-labelled coverage or real-take accuracy.
Operator-labelled coverage reflects the bound annotation store only; absence of labels is not evidence of correctness.
The bundle establishes provenance, not listening acceptance, note correctness, meter, tonic, mode or the presence of the ~32.7 Hz fundamental.
verify --check-origin rehashes member origins but not the run's stage WAVs; rebuild to rehash them.

dependencies.note: Bundles whatever bound evidence exists; missing or rejected analysis and payloads stay visible as statuses and the report abstains.

agent_workflow.identify: Confirm the run and its manifest-recorded stage hashes; note which analysis basis (run_local, explicit, parent_run_from_capture_profile_authoring_dir) applies.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/sprints/REPORT_S2.md; keep binding classes and claim classes visible when quoting receipt figures.
agent_workflow.iterate: Rebuild into a fresh output directory after any input change; never edit a bundle in place. Run verify --check-origin before relying on a bundle.
agent_workflow.acceptance: verified status and protected readback are provenance checks only; listening acceptance and any default adoption remain operator/root decisions.
